title: 【0 Formaldehyde】Epoxy Floor Paint Floor colored sand floor paint cat lantai simen Indoor and outdoor home renovation pai
description:
【0 Formaldehyde】Epoxy Floor Paint Floor colored sand floor paint cat lantai simen Indoor and outdoor home renovation pai
FREE 1pc brush and 1 pair disposable gloves
【Product Name】Epoxy colored sand floor paint
【Capacity】1000G
【Applicable Environment】Indoor and outdoor floors
【Painting Area】1 kg can cover 3.5 square meter
【Colors】Gemstone Blue/Emerald Green/Beige/Light Gray
【Construction Method】Troweling
【Storage】Seal for 12 months
Usage steps
STEP.1
Base surface treatment
Clean the floating dust and stains on the base surface.
Use a roller to evenly apply the primer on the ground and wait for it to dry. (This step can be omitted for tile and marble floors.)
STEP.2
Scrape flat the floor paint
Fully stir the colored sand floor paint and the curing agent, then pour it on the ground and scrape it flat (the ratio is approximately 6:1).
STEP.3
Finish the work
Finally, use a defoaming roller to roll back and forth for defoaming treatment.It will dry in about 12 - 24 hours. It can be used after drying.
Precautions
1. When constructing outdoors, an outdoor interface agent needs to be applied.
2. It is recommended to use an electric drill for stirring if available.
3. It can come into contact with water after 24 hours, and after 72 hours when it is completely dry, forklifts can pass over it.
4. The troweling operation should be completed within 15 - 20 minutes, otherwise, it will solidify in the bucket. This must be emphasized.
5. If the ground is uneven, it needs to be leveled before construction, otherwise, it may result in insufficient usage.
